kontakt1: Do you have technical questions about our PP-R/PPRCT pipes or do you need support for an international project? The K Aqua contact team in Waldsolms will be happy to assist you.

projektanfrage1: Are you planning a pioneering construction project? Send us your project request for K Aqua PP-R and PPRCT piping systems. Our technical department in Waldsolms specializes in the design and dimensioning of large installations. This includes demanding high-rise buildings, hygienically sensitive hospitals, extensive district cooling networks and complex industrial cooling and heating systems. Thanks to our decades of experience in polymer engineering, we understand the specific hydraulic and thermal requirements placed on the infrastructure of modern buildings. With K Aqua you choose not just a product, but a holistic system solution.
projektanfrage2: As soon as you provide us with your detailed project specifications, P&ID plans or isometrics, our specialist engineers begin a deep analysis. We support you with complex pressure loss calculations, the determination of thermal linear expansion and the exact positioning of fixed and sliding points. We also create precise bills of materials and design tailor-made transition fittings for connecting to large metal components. Our goal is to design a hydraulically perfectly balanced pipe network for you that minimizes the energy consumption of your pumps and guarantees a maintenance-free service life of over 50 years.
projektanfrage3: Discretion and reliability are our top priorities. Every project inquiry is treated strictly confidentially and processed exclusively by our qualified German engineering team. We also coordinate global logistics and ensure that our high-end pipes and fittings arrive at your construction site on time and undamaged. In addition, we offer on-site welder training by our certified instructors to ensure that the installation is carried out exactly according to the specifications of German Engineering. With K Aqua you ensure maximum efficiency, absolute freedom from leaks and the longevity of your entire piping system.
